name: Rachael Millsom
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Rachael works collaboratively with her clients, often using nature, mindfulness, somatic resources and creative therapies. Rachael is trained as a level 1 sensorimotor psychotherapist, exploring ways patterns from our past, including trauma, show up in the body. Rachael is also informed in her work by ideas from narrative therapy, strength based approaches, attachment theory, and systems theory.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Dalit Bar
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: At Mindsight Counselling, I offer a calm and supportive space for adults, children, and families seeking counselling and art therapy in Bayside Melbourne. With over 20 years’ experience in counselling and art therapy across Melbourne, I work with warmth, curiosity, and respect to help clients make sense of what’s feeling difficult and move towards greater clarity, balance, and emotional wellbeing. I support clients through anxiety, grief and loss, life transitions, relationship challenges, and feeling emotional overwhelmed.

name: Anna Marie Steyn
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: "Where connection meets healing through creative expression". My approach is person-centred and integrative, drawing from evidence-based modalities including Internal Family Systems (IFS), trauma-informed practices and CBT. Whether you're navigating loss, processing trauma, or seeking support through life's transitions, I'm here to walk alongside you.

name: Harald Riedel
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
address: Beach Street Allied Health     103 Beach Street
description: As well as working in private practice, Harald assumes another role, which encompasses mental health program worker at an Adult Prevention and Recovery Centre (APARC) for a mental health and disability organisation. In addition, Harald facilitates mindfulness, meditation, and therapeutic groups both within the community and organisational context. Harald has an extensive history of practical experience and knowledge, including over six years working in mental health and several years in hospital and rehabilitation settings.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy
